d.d: Doubtful or uncertain about the existence or demonstrability of God or other deity.
d.x: She left the church when she had become agnostic.

d.d: Having no firmly held opinions on something.
d.x: I'm agnostic on whether ethanol is a green fuel.

d.d: Of or relating to agnosticism or its adherents.
d.x: His agnostic viewpoint is summarized in his book.

d.d: A person who holds to a form of agnosticism, especially uncertainty of the existence of a deity.
The view that absolute truth or ultimate certainty is unattainable, especially regarding knowledge not based on experience or perceivable phenomena.
The view that the existence of God or of all deities is unknown, unknowable, unproven, or unprovable.
Doubt, uncertainty, or scepticism regarding the existence of a god or gods.
